# Test Fixtures

Status: **Scaffold only. No fixtures exist yet.**

Rules:

- Use generated or fake project content only.
- Never copy personal projects or real source code.
- Never place real secrets, tokens, paths, or credentials here.
- Fixture scripts must never be executed by tests.
- Sensitive-file fixtures must contain unmistakably fake values and remain deny-listed.
- Tests must create temporary mutable fixtures for rename/delete/restore scenarios.
- Clean up temporary directories on success and failure.

The required fixture matrix is defined in [../../docs/TESTING.md](../../docs/TESTING.md).
